Package com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

The runtime system domain API is specifically designed to support runtime system related use cases.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    IAbstractComponentPortSelector
    The IAbstractComponentPortSelector API defines predicates for component port selector APIs.
    ICommunicationElementAutoMapper
    ICommunicationElementAutoMapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the auto-data-mapping of communication elements to signal instances.
    ICommunicationElementSelection
    ICommunicationElementSelection represents a selection of ICommunicationElements and the possible operations on these communication elements.
    ICommunicationElementSelector
    The ICommunicationElementSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for communication element selection.
    ICommunicationElementUnmapper
    ICommunicationElementUnmapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the unmapping of ICommunicationElements from their mapped IAbstractSignalInstances.
    IComponentPortAutoMapper
    IComponentPortAutoMapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the auto-mapping.
    IComponentPortSelection
    IComponentPortSelection represents a selection of IComponentPorts and the possible operations on these component ports.
    IComponentPortSelector
    The IComponentPortSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for component port selection.
    IComponentPortUnmapper
    IComponentPortUnmapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the unmapping of IComponentPorts from their connected IComponentPorts.

    IComponentTypeSelection
    IComponentTypeSelection represents a selection of IComponentTypes and the possible operations on these component types.
    IComponentTypeSelector
    The IComponentTypeSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for component type selection.

    IElementSelector
    The IElementSelector API allows the definition of base predicates for several other selector APIs.
    IEventSelection
    IEventSelection represents a selection of IEvents and the possible operations on these events.
    IEventSelector
    The IEventSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for event (also called trigger) selection.
    IExecutableEntitySelection
    IExecutableEntitySelection represents a selection of IExecutableEntitys and the possible operations on these.
    IExecutableEntitySelector
    The IExecutableEntitySelector Api allows the definition of predicates for executable entities (also called functions) selection.
    IExecutionOrderConstraintSelector
    The IExecutionOrderConstraintSelector Api allows the definition of predicates to select execution order constraints.
    IOriginComponentPortSelection
    IOriginComponentPortSelection represents a selection of IOriginComponentPorts which can be used as additional information for other operations.
    IOriginComponentPortSelector
    The IOriginComponentPortSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for the selection of origin component ports.
    IPortInterfaceSelection
    IPortInterfaceSelection represents a selection of IPortInterfaces and the possible operations on these port interfaces.
    IPortInterfaceSelector
    The IPortInterfaceSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for port interface selection.

    IRuntimeSystemApiEntryPoint
    IRuntimeSystemApiEntryPoint is the entry point for accessing the runtime system domain interfaces.

    ISelectedCommunicationElements
    ISelectedCommunicationElements represents a selection of ICommunicationElements and provides further actions on it.

    ISignalInstanceAutoMapper
    ISignalInstanceAutoMapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the auto-data-mapping of signal instances to communication elements.
    ISignalInstanceSelection
    ISignalInstanceSelection represents a selection of IAbstractSignalInstances (ISignalInstance and ISignalGroupInstance) and the possible operations on these signal instances.
    ISignalInstanceSelector
    The ISignalInstanceSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for signal selection.
    ISignalInstanceUnmapper
    ISignalInstanceUnmapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the unmapping of IAbstractSignalInstances from their mapped ICommunicationElements.
    ISourceComponentPortSelector
    The ISourceComponentPortSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for component port selection.
    ITargetComponentPortSelector
    The ITargetComponentPortSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for target component port selection.
    ITaskMapper
    ITaskMapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the task mapping.
    ITaskMappingSelector
    The ITaskMappingSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for ITaskMapping selection.
    ITaskMappingSuccessorChain
    ITaskMappingSuccessorChain stores the successors defined for a task mapping.
    ITaskMappingSuccessorDefinition
    ITaskMappingSuccessorDefinition provides an API to specify the order of the task mappings by defining successor relationships.
    ITaskSelector
    The ITaskSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for task selection.
    IUnmappedComElementAndSignalResult
    IUnmappedComElementAndSignalResult represents an ICommunicationElement and an IAbstractSignalInstance which were previously mapped to each other by an IDataMapping and are unmapped now.
    IUnmappedPortsResult
    IUnmappedPortsResult represents two IComponentPorts that were previously connected by an IConnector and are disconnected (unmapped) now.
